Inspector Career Track — From Level I to Multi-Method Level III

Career track decomposed: (1) Level I — assist, gather data, follow procedure; 40-80h classroom + 3-6 months OJE per method; (2) Level II — independent setup + acquisition + interpretation; 3-12 months Level I experience + method-specific Level II exam (general + specific + practical); (3) Level III — Procedure authoring, training programs, NDE technique development; 18-36 months Level II experience + Multi-Method basic exam + method-specific exam + Procedure development demonstration. Atlantis Academy structures every cohort with Procedure Qualification Record (PQR) authoring + Written Practice template authoring practice + practical fault-block experience.
